pages.text: For beer, add five wheat and two hop cones to a tub of water. Let the batch finish mashing and reach fermented beer in the tub. Draw a serving or move it into a barrel to age.
For wine, mash eight grapes, ferment to wash, then age in a barrel until the wine reaches the style you want. For brandy, move the fermented wash through the distillery before aging.
For rum, mash seven cane, ferment to basi, then move the fermented brew into the distillery. Draw young rum and age it in a barrel for a different style.
For other spirits, distill fermented wheat or potato for vodka. Age distilled wheat for wheat whiskey and potato for poteen. Distilled juniper makes gin.

pages.title: Choose the Route
pages.text: The style comes from the fluid and its process stages. Look at the tooltip before transferring. Refer to $(l:psychedelicraft:processing/aging)barrel aging$(/l) and $(l:psychedelicraft:processing/distilling)the distillery$(/l) for machine conditions.
